title: Acompañamiento electoral en Venezuela
description: El presente plan de iniciación tiene por tanto un doble objetivo: en primer lugar, pretende poder responder a la solicitud de las autoridades venezolanas a través de un apoyo técnico y logístico al eventual despliegue del panel de expertos de la ONU y a otras misiones de observación electoral. En segundo lugar, el plan de iniciación deberá permitir explorar la posibilidad de un apoyo por parte del PNUD en materia de asistencia electoral más a medio plazo y que pueda cubrir las fases pre, durante y post elecciones con vistas también a las citas electorales programadas para 2025 (elecciones locales y legislativas).

title: Building Bridges of Trust: Fostering Multi-Actor and Multi-Level Confidence to Promote Social Cohesion in Venezuela
description: The first phase of the project aimed at establishing platforms and mechanisms for social dialogue that foster the inclusive and meaningful participation of civil society organizations and social movements, including women, youth, academia, and the private sector which contributed to the efforts of the various stakeholders to achieve a peaceful, just and inclusive Venezuelan society.In light of the recent July 2024 presidential election and the upcoming regional and parliamentary elections in 2025, Venezuelas political landscape remains complex and uncertain. The coming months will be critical, as the outcome could have significant regional implications for migration and stability, marking a pivotal moment in determining the countrys path to recovery. Promoting initiatives and inclusive dialogues that build trust and help bridge different narratives among national actors is essential to strengthen the social fabric and foster social cohesion while creating the enabling conditions for an inclusive and sustainable development in the country.UNDP’s strategy focuses on three key areas:1.	Restoring Trust: fostering inclusive dialogue spaces that transform relationships and perspectives among actors, supporting the collaborative development of proposals for the country’s recovery and sustainable development.2.	Enhancing National Capacities for Dialogue: strengthening actors capacities to engage in initiatives that strengthen the social fabric and promote social cohesion.3.	Promoting Inclusive Narratives: developing initiatives for joint reflection to build resilient and peaceful societies, while shaping sustainable development strategies and initiatives that enhance social cohesion, advancing the triple nexus approach.Strengthening these dialogue spaces and enhancing coordinated actions will contribute to a conducive environment for fostering a culture of peace and promote dialogue as a transformative approach for sustainable development and a mechanism for redres
